scope: Local exploratory one-frame Panda probe, single repeat. Uses supplied local prototype numerical code and model, not the original repository verifier or server. No robot trajectories, no TRAC/Pink, no GitHub writes.
design_sequence: Interior-offset probe: all methods accepted all 360 inputs.

After inspecting that result, a new, explicitly near-dynamic-boundary probe was specified. All 360 inputs were stored and witnesses checked before running any method. No input was excluded based on solver outcomes.
independent_units: 240 geometric anchor states, 120 per probe. Three offset levels share each anchor. This is exploratory development, not a held-out population test.
verification: independent homogeneous-transform FK for every witness and returned command; original server verifier still required
